# testdata

| File | Origin |
|---|---|
| `default.css` | Synthesised: the stylesheet generated for the built-in `default` theme. A golden file, rewritten with `TRICA_UPDATE_THEME_FILES=1 go test ./internal/theme`; read the diff before committing it. |
| `flat.css` | Synthesised: the same for the built-in `flat` theme. |

Nothing here is recorded from equipment, and nothing needs anonymising. The test archives are built in memory by the tests.
